title: Attention Intelligence as an AI-era editorial skill
audience: Founder, operator, or editorial reviewer evaluating a source-aware AI workflow
editorial_question: Can the concept of Attention Intelligence be framed from a small, reviewable source set without overstating research consensus or publication rights?
scope: Define Attention Intelligence as a working editorial frame.
Connect the frame to AI-assisted work and review burden.
Identify what is supported, ambiguous, and intentionally not claimed.
out_of_scope: Scientific validation of a new cognitive construct.
Claims about school adoption, customer demand, or clinical outcomes.
success_criteria: Every substantive claim is mapped to at least one source card or marked unsupported.
Rights status is reviewed before the narrative brief is marked ready.
Human editorial review records limitations and allowed use.
